## Context

Which framework, component type, and styling setup did you try?

## Change you attempted

Show the smallest before/after markup and CSS that made the Nagi CSS constraint useful or burdensome.

## Diagnostic

Which rule and message did you receive? Was the result correct, a false positive, or an analysis boundary?

## Adoption condition

What would need to remain true—or change—for you to use this contract on component-owned CSS?

Please include a reduced repository or code excerpt when possible. Remove private product data first.
